text.ko: 업종 내 매우 약함. 약점: 자기자본이익률(ROE) 0.4%.

text.en: Very weak within its sector. Strength: Revenue growth consistency 75%. Weakness: 3-yr revenue growth (annual) -19.3%.

text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: Price to book 1.27x. Weakness: PEG ratio n/m (negative).

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경의 영향은 중립적이에요. 주요 요인: 금리 상승 국면 (불리). 부채가 적어 금리 영향은 덜해요.
text.en: The current economy is roughly neutral for this sector. Main factor: rising rates (hurts). Low debt cushions rate effects.
